why_it_moved.text: The effect is stable by days since exposure: +0.81% early, +0.80% late, so it is not a novelty bump.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: No segment cuts were in the scorecard, so which queries gain is not known.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: The pre period could not be checked. A pre-exposure comparison showing the arms already differed on Successful Search Rate would make the test unreliable.
A rollout holdout where the lift lands below 0.50% would argue for stopping, since the low end of the interval is under the bar.
